Think twice before buying Yeezys. I wish I had known what I was getting myself into when I first placed this order. What was supposed to be six pairs of slides turned into three pairs, and after all of that, only two pairs were actually delivered. Let me start from the beginning. In August 2025, the Yeezy website was running a promotion where the slides were only $20 each, plus tax and shipping. I placed my order on time, hoping everything would arrive before Christmas so I could give a pair to each of my nieces, nephews, and my own kids. Fast-forward six months, and I still hadn’t received anything. I emailed the company back and forth repeatedly. What started as six months eventually turned into almost a year of dealing with this situation. I was told they could no longer refund my money because the original purchase was from the previous year. Instead, they gave me a code to place another order. The problem? The slides were no longer $20, so I couldn’t purchase the same number of pairs with the amount I originally paid. I ended up using the code to purchase three pairs of slides, and once again, I had to pay shipping. Fast-forward another four weeks. My package finally arrives, and guess what? Only two pairs were delivered. I immediately contacted them asking what happened to the third pair, and once again—no response, no explanation, nothing. I later found out that my order had been placed on hold and was showing as partially delivered. Honestly, I have never in my life had to email a company back and forth this many times just to receive an order I already paid for. This entire experience has been extremely frustrating and disappointing. Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend spending your money with this company. I would think twice before ordering from them.
